question: In the November 2025 by-elections, which of the following political parties won the by-election from Budgam (Jammu and Kashmir)?

options.text: Jammu and Kashmir Peoples Democratic Party

solution:
The correct answer is __**जम्मू एंड कश्मीर पीपुल्स डेमोक्रेटिक पार्टी**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the by-elections (उपचुनाव) held in **November 2025**, the **Jammu and Kashmir Peoples Democratic Party (JKPDP)** won the seat from the **Budgam** constituency.
 
• By-elections are conducted by the **Election Commission of India** to fill vacancies that arise in the State Legislative Assembly or Parliament before the completion of the full term.
 
• The **Budgam** constituency is a significant political segment located in the **Budgam district** of the **Kashmir Division**, known for its high political engagement and strategic importance in the **Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir**.
 
• The victory of the **JKPDP** in this election reflects the party's localized support base and its standing among the electorate in the central part of the valley. ***Hence, the correct answer is जम्मू एंड कश्मीर पीपुल्स डेमोक्रेटिक पार्टी.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Jammu and Kashmir Peoples Democratic Party (JKPDP):**

 
 
• The party was founded in **1999** by the former Union Home Minister **Mufti Mohammad Sayeed**.
 
• The current president of the party is **Mehbooba Mufti**, who also served as the first female Chief Minister of the erstwhile state of **Jammu and Kashmir**.
 
• The **election symbol** of the JKPDP is an **Inkpot and Pen**, and the party is headquartered in **Srinagar**.
 
• The party's core ideology revolves around **self-rule** and acting as a bridge between the people of the region and the central government.
 
 
 
• **Budgam District:**
 
 
• **Budgam** was carved out from the **Srinagar district** in the year **1979**.
 
• It is home to the only civilian airport in the valley, the **Sheikh ul-Alam International Airport**.
 
• Administratively, it is a key part of the **Union Territory** governance framework established after the **Jammu and Kashmir Reorganisation Act, 2019**.
 
 
 
• **Legislative Context:**
 
 
• Following the **delimitation exercise** completed in **2022**, the total number of seats in the **Jammu and Kashmir Legislative Assembly** was increased to **90** (excluding seats reserved for POK).
 
• Elections and by-elections in the region are governed by the **Representation of the People Act, 1951**, and overseen by the **Election Commission of India**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **By-elections (By-polls):** These are usually held within **six months** of a seat becoming vacant, as per the statutory requirements in India.
 
• **Political Landscape:** The **Union Territory** of **Jammu and Kashmir** currently functions under a unique administrative setup where the **Lieutenant Governor** holds significant executive powers, while the **Legislative Assembly** deals with specific state subjects.
 
• **November 2025 Context:** The electoral results of this period are crucial for assessing the shifting political dynamics between major regional players like the **National Conference (NC)** and the **Peoples Democratic Party (PDP)**.
